translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Hewaa diraw, Yisaak'i Yaak'ooba s'eesiide hawaadan anjjeedanne azazeedda; «Kanaane gadiyaa mac'c'a naanatuwaappe new machchatto akkoppa.
Dendda! Ne daay aawuwaa Baatu'eelakko, Masp'p'es'oomiyaa gadiyaa baade yaappe ne daay ishaa Laabaana mac'c'a naanatuwaappe ittinno new machchatto ootsaade akka.
Ubbaa Danddayiyaa S'oossay neena anjjo; I ne yeletaa aasso; neeni itti dere asaa keena gakkanaw neena c'orisso.
Neeni ha"i betetetsan utteedda ha biittaa newaa ootsana mala newunne ne zeretsaw S'oossay Abrahaame anjjuwaa immo» yaageedda.
Yisaak'i Yaak'ooba yeddeedda; Yaak'oobi Masp'p'es'oomiyaa gadiyaa Laabaanakko beedda. Laabaani Yaak'oobanne Eesaa yeleedda aati Ribik'a ishaanne Sooriyaa Baatu'eela na'aa.
Eesay Hara Machchiyaa Gujjiide Akkeedda
Yisaak'i Yaak'ooba anjjeedawaanne, yaappe machchatto akkanaw Masp'p'es'oomiyaa gadiyaa Aa yedeeddawaa, k'ay I Yaak'ooba anjjeedda wode, «Kanaane mac'c'a asaa akkoppa» yaagiide azazeeddawaanne,
Yaak'oobi bare aawuwaanne bare aatonne azazettiide, Masp'p'es'oomiyaa gadiyaa beeddawaa Eesay ereedda.
Eesay hewaan Kanaane biittaa mac'c'awunna bare aawuwaa Yisaak'a ay keeshshaa iitintto akeekeedda.
Hewaa diraw Eesay Abrahaame na'aa Isimaa'eelekko biide, Aa naatto Maahilaato bare machatuwaa bolla gujjiide akkeedda. Iza Nabaayoota michchato.
Yaak'oobi Beeteelen Be'eedda Akumuwaa
Yaak'oobi Berssaabeheppe Kaaraane baanaw denddeedda.
I itti sa'aa gakkina away wullina, yan k'ammaa ak'eeda. He sa'aan de'iyaa shuchchatuwaappe ittuwaa akkiidde, bare huup'iyaan borkkotiide he sa'aan gem"isheedda.
I akumuwaa akumeteedda; he akumuwaan gayyiyaa ittuu biittan ek'k'ina, aw s'eeray saluwaa gakkiyaawaan, S'oossaa kiitanchchatuu gi"ishiinanne wod'd'ishin be'eedda;
gayyiyaw bolla s'eeran Med'inaa Goday ek'k'iide Aa, «Taani Med'inaa Godaa, ne aawuwaa Abrahaama S'oossaa, Yisaak'a S'oossaa. Ha neeni giseedda biittaa newunne ne zeretsaw immana;

Ne zeretsay sa'aa shafiyaadan darana; neeni away wulliyaa baggananne, away doliyaa baggana, huup'issananne hirkki baggana de'iyaa sa'aa gakkanaw aakkana; sa'aa bollan de'iyaa Asay ubbay ne baggananne ne zeretsaa baggana
anjjettana
Taani neenana de'ay; neeni biyaasa'aa ubbaan taani neena naagana; k'ay taani neena ha gadiyaa guyye zaaraade ahana; taani new ootsana geeddawaa ootsana gakkanaw neena yeggikke» yaageedda.
Yaak'oobi gem"ishuwaappe beegotteedda wode, «Med'inaa Goday tumu ha sa'aan de'ee; taani erabeykkeppe attin» yaageedda.
I yayyiide, «Ha sa'ay wooti yashshii! Ha sa'ay S'oossaa golliyaappe attin, ayinne hara sa'aa gidenna; hawe saluwaa penggiyaa» yaageedda.
Wonttetsa gallassi wontta guuran Yaak'oobi denddiide, bare borkkoteedda shuchchaa akkiidde, tuussaadan essiide, S'oossaw dummayanaw Aa bolla zayitiyaa tigeedda.
Yaak'oobi he sa'aa Beeteele
giide s'eeseedda. Shin he katamay hewaappe kase Looza geetettee.

Yaak'oobi hawaadan yaagiide shiik'k'eedda; «Ta aawuwaa soo taani saro simmana mala S'oossay taananna gidooppe, taani biyaa ha buussan taana naagooppenne taw miyaa k'umaanne mayiyaa mayuwaa immooppe, Med'inaa Goday ta S'oossaa gidana;
taani tuussaadan esseedda ha shuchchay S'oossaa golliyaa gidana. Neeni taw immiyaawaa ubbaappe tammuwaappe ittuwaa taani new immana» yaageedda.

footnotes.text: Ne baggananne ne zeretsaa baggana: Sa'aa bollan de'iyaa asay ubbay neenanne ne zeretsaa anjjowaadan anjjana mala taana woosana guussaa.
Beeteele: Ha suntsaa biletsay Ibraaweetsuwaan, «S'oossaa Golliyaa» giyaawaa.
